# @canopy/auth

Canopy authentication: API keys and bring your own identity provider JWTs verified through JWKS, turned into DLS request contexts.

Used by the REST, GraphQL and realtime handlers. Built in user accounts are `@canopy/auth-builtin`.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/auth
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

<!-- snippet: declare const bearerToken: string | undefined -->

```ts
import { Authenticator } from "@canopy/auth"

const authenticator = new Authenticator(
  {
    jwksUrl: "https://YOUR_TENANT.auth0.com/.well-known/jwks.json",
    issuer: "https://YOUR_TENANT.auth0.com/",
    audience: "https://api.example.com",
  },
  { publishable: ["pk_app"] },
)
const principal = await authenticator.authenticate("pk_app", bearerToken)
principal.context.roles // anon, or authenticated plus the token's roles
```
